observations: The isolated probe provisioned trusted installation metadata and executed native Aurora models on core47 plus explicit source overlays.

Its artifact metadata came from the AT-A synthetic packaging fixture; that fixture deliberately raises if imported. The authority probe did not materialize that archive as its native application source.
The probe proves original actor/resource checks, queue deduplication and fencing. It does not establish artifact-source admission, managed startup or exact deployed native application integrity.
required_follow_up: AT-03 native authority must check metadata against the current inventoried application artifact. AT-E/AT-04 must execute real admitted archive code through startup, jobs and lifecycle. Preserve the early receipt; do not treat it as release qualification.
